segments.text: Lesson 131. Practice.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: Listen to the completed conversation. Then practice the parts.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: Where are you going to spend your holidays this year, Gary?
segments.instructions: Ask a neutral information question with a gentle falling finish.

segments.text: We may go abroad.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: I'm not sure.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: My wife wants to go to Egypt.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: I'd like to go there, too.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: We can't make up our minds.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: Will you travel by sea or by air?
segments.instructions: Ask a choice question, rising on the first choice and falling on the final choice.

segments.text: We may travel by sea. It may be cheaper, but it takes a long time.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: I'm sure you'll enjoy yourselves.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: Don't be so sure!
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: We might not go anywhere!
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: My wife always worries too much.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: Who's going to look after the dog, the house and the garden?
segments.instructions: Ask a neutral information question with a gentle falling finish.

segments.text: In the end, we stay at home and look after everything!
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: Complete the items on the page. Pause to try each one, then listen to the completed version.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: Last year we spent holidays in Italy.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: Not many Chinese people go abroad for their holidays.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: Please make up your mind. Are you coming with us or not?
segments.instructions: Ask a choice question, rising on the first choice and falling on the final choice.

segments.text: Can you look after the dog for us while we are away?
segments.instructions: Ask a genuine question with a gentle natural rise.

segments.text: My friend never travels by air because she is always ill in a plane.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.
